leadText:
Tito (Japanese: リト Rito) is a minor recurring character in Pokémon Journeys: The Series.

Tito first appeared in The Cuteness Quotient!, in which he competed in the Friendship Festival with his but did not manage to win a prize.

Tito reappeared in On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, where he was among the competitors taking part in the Kids Marine Athletic Race. He ended up finishing third.
